session_reference.method: Latest observed monthly US date across matched price files

methodology.return: Last observed US month-end adjClose / previous month-end adjClose - 1.
methodology.difference: Lazy return minus Tiingo return, in percentage points.
methodology.alignment: Exact month matching and both price endpoints equal local observed US endpoints; no fill or month shifting.
methodology.calendar: Maximum observed month-end across matched US files; final month excluded if ending before the final weekday. Conservative if that weekday was a holiday.
methodology.identity: Exact ticker/file-stem match within explicit US exchange folders. No ASX price files or FX conversion.
methodology.cagr: Compounded monthly simple returns, annualized using 12 / number of months; only contiguous periods.
methodology.proxy: Full overlap and months after published broad proxy cutoff are reported. This cutoff is not proof of a precise reconstruction transition.
